command_invalid.name: command_invalid
command_invalid.long_description: The specified command is invalid or not recognized.

command_amount.name: amount
command_amount.long_description: Controls or specifies a general amount value.

command_audiobitrate.name: audiobitrate
command_audiobitrate.long_description: Specifies the audio bitrate to use per stream mapping.

command_audiochannels.name: audiochannels
command_audiochannels.long_description: Specifies or adjusts the number of audio channels.

command_audiocodec.name: audiocodec
command_audiocodec.long_description: Specifies which audio codec should be used.

command_audiostreams.name: audiostreams
command_audiostreams.long_description: Controls or selects audio streams in the media.

command_bitrate.name: bitrate
command_bitrate.long_description: Configures bitrate for media encoding or processing.

command_crop.name: crop
command_crop.long_description: Applies cropping parameters to video content.

command_constrain.name: constrain
command_constrain.long_description: Applies constraints on encoding or processing parameters.

command_crf.name: crf
command_crf.long_description: Sets the Constant Rate Factor (CRF) for quality control.

command_displayrefresh.name: displayrefresh
command_displayrefresh.long_description: Specifies or adjusts the display refresh rate.

command_encoder.name: encoder
command_encoder.long_description: Specifies the encoder to be used for processing media.

command_help.name: help
command_help.long_description: Displays help information for available commands.

command_info.name: info
command_info.long_description: Displays detailed information about media or configuration.

command_loggingoptions.name: loggingoptions
command_loggingoptions.long_description: Controls the format or verbosity of logging output.

command_overwrite.name: overwrite
command_overwrite.long_description: Controls whether output files may be overwritten.

command_quality.name: quality
command_quality.long_description: Controls general quality settings for encoding.

command_start.name: start
command_start.long_description: Begins processing or initiates execution of a task.

command_subtitle.name: subtitle
command_subtitle.long_description: Manages subtitle streams or settings in the media.

command_trim.name: trim
command_trim.long_description: Cuts or trims media to specified durations.

command_tune.name: tune
command_tune.long_description: Applies tuning presets to optimize encoding for specific content types.
